column3: The Hebrew names “gray hair” and “the face of an old man”; BSB uses “the elderly” and “the aged.”
The Hebrew prohibits injustice “in judgment” as well as in measurement, weight, and capacity; BSB combines these under dishonest measures.
The Hebrew uses the literal “stones” for weights and repeats the righteousness word for each of the four measuring instruments; BSB says “weights” and varies “honest” with the list.
